QuestInfo.1: #p3001004# wants some Specter items in his shop. Eliminate #b100#k #r#o2400110##k monsters at the #b#m401040300##k and obtain #b30 #t4033360##k items.
QuestInfo.2: You brought #p3001004# the new merchandise...  but will they really sell well? Go check in with #b#p3001005##k.Specter Materials

0.0: Greetings once more, champion! I seek to expand my already considerable selection of wares. Have you perchance heard of Blue Ocean?
0.1: There's this candy that #o2400110# monsters really like. I mean, they just ADORE it. I call it #b#t4033360##k, and apparently it improves their concentration, aids in awakening their latent powers, and other sundry effects.
0.2: I was actually able to obtain one in secret, and its effects... AMAZING! If I sell this, it's going to be a jackpot! To mass-produce it, however, I need some more samples to analyze the components.
0.3: Please eliminate #b100#k #r#o2400110##k monsters and bring me 30 #b#t4033360##k items. I should be able to figure out the components with them.

yes.0: Ah, much appreciated, noble guardian. This won't be too taxing with your considerable strength.

no.0: Come now, I called you all the way here and you refuse my simple request?

1.0: So, did you bring the requested items?

yes.0: Ah, those really are #b#t4033360##k! Yes, these should be enough! Ahhh, just look at the profits, dancing about my head!

item.0: You didn't obtain 30 #b#t4033360##k items yet. Unacceptable!

mob.0: Eliminate 100 #r#o2400110##k monsters, would you kindly? I have the distinct impression that you have not completed this task.
